items.title: Georg Brunis Interview, 1958-06-03
items.q: we put Mel Stitzel and Ben Pollock in... So he's in on it, and Melrose got the publishers right, and I got the writer, and Paul, and Pollock, Teenie. So we made a few bucks

ctx.x: And he took it and he put these lyrics to it. I've seen the bright lights burning up and down Broadway, there's no lights burning like my hometown. And, well then at that time we put rap in, no rap Paul and I, and then we put Mel Stitzel and Ben Pollock in, you know, because we didn't figure it was going to do anything.
No, just put all the names down.
